title: 英伟达临时CEO人选浮出水面 关键人物风险与治理安排受关注
speaker: Bloomberg

segments.en: Venice now, Sara Rahe, Portfolio Manager at Franklin Templeton.
segments.zh: 现在来自威尼斯，Sara Araghi，富兰克林邓普顿的**组合经理。

segments.en: A big owner of a video, cross-funds about 0.5%.
segments.zh: 某视频平台的大股东，交叉基金约0.5%。

segments.en: The Sara's also a partner of Franklin Venture. In the portfolio, lots of companies.
segments.zh: Sara也是富兰克林风险**的合伙人。在**组合中，有许多公司。

segments.en: They're in the AI ecosystem just to start your reaction to gents amongst resignation pleas.
segments.zh: 他们处于AI生态系统中，先谈谈你对高管辞职请求的反应。

segments.en: Yeah, well, thank you for having me today. It highlights the idea behind key man risk and as institutional investors,
segments.zh: 好的，感谢今天邀请我。这凸显了关键人风险的理念，作为机构市场参与者，

segments.en: we are always evaluating that, making sure that we look at boards and their governance committees and how they're evaluating succession planning,
segments.zh: 我们一直在评估这一点，确保我们关注董事会及其治理委员会，以及他们如何评估继任计划，

segments.en: how they're looking at planning for events like this and, you know, the board has to act in the best interests of shareholders.
segments.zh: 他们如何为此类事件做规划，而且，你知道，董事会必须为股东的最佳利益行事。

segments.en: And so this is something that, you know, they've had to take action on here.
segments.zh: 所以这是他们不得不采取行动的事情。

segments.en: And so we're seeing the results of that.
Collette Cress becomes interim CEO and also in parallel stays as CFO.
segments.zh: 科莱特·克雷斯成为临时CEO，同时继续担任CFO。

segments.en: She's a known quantity to you, to many. Yes. Tell me about Collette Cress.
segments.zh: 她对你和许多人来说都是熟悉的面孔。是的。跟我说说科莱特·克雷斯。

segments.en: Yeah, look, the buy side and sell side knows Collette very well.
segments.zh: 买方和卖方都非常了解科莱特。

segments.en: Investors spend time with her. We spend time with her multiple times a year.
segments.zh: 市场参与者花时间与她交流。我们每年与她交流多次。

segments.en: Collette has been with a company over 13 years now. She, you know, you just showed her background.
segments.zh: 科莱特在公司工作超过13年了。你刚刚展示了她的背景。

segments.en: She's been at Microsoft, Texas Instruments, Cisco. She knows the industry since the 90s.
segments.zh: 她曾在微软、德州仪器、思科工作。她从90年代就了解这个行业。

segments.en: She's been in the industry. And so she's very familiar with, of course, the semi-space, but also just in video.
segments.zh: 她一直在行业内。所以她非常熟悉半导体领域，当然也熟悉英伟达。
